## Built for Progress. Shaped by Innovation. Loved by Surf Schools.

For over a decade, Liquid Shredder boards have been the go-to for surf schools and families who want
gear that makes learning easier and keeps the stoke high. From the first paddle-out to those glassy
summer evenings, our EZ-Slider line is known for its forgiving rocker and rock-solid stability,
while Storm Born adds epoxy-infused durability and a carry handle for daily wear-and-tear.

[Our Story][29]
Why Ride with Liquid Shredder

### 1. Built for Every Rider

From your first wave to your thousandth, we’ve got you covered. Soft-tops, SUPs, bodyboards — every
shape, every size, every style. The largest selection of surfboards and paddleboards online.

Why Ride with Liquid Shredder

### 2. Trusted by the Pros

Used by surf schools, instructors, and professionals around the world. Featured on NBC’s *Today
Show* and in the *UK Daily Mail *— our boards define quality and performance in the water.

Why Ride with Liquid Shredder

### 3. 20+ Years of Innovation

Handcrafted with Peruvian heritage and advanced tech since 1999.

# Bringing the fun
# to skateboarding

# Skater Owned AND Operated

Absolute Board Co. proudly owns and distributes some of the most reputable brands in the surf,
skate, lifestyle and fashion channels.

Formerly named Absolute Distributors, today Absolute Board Co. products are sold in over sixty
countries worldwide, with offices and production facilities in Australia, UK, USA, China, and
Taiwan.

# OUR STORY

Absolute Board Co stems from an Australian backyard garage sale in 1983 where a searching
five-year-old boy stumbled upon an old worn out plastic skateboard.

Eagerly he took this little skateboard home and with his father’s help, stripped it apart and
rebuilt it piece by piece. This was the start for Absolute Board Co.’s founder and director Ben. As
the years went on Ben’s passion for skateboarding grew as he became more and more absorbed in the
culture. To him, it was the only movement that mattered. At the age of 15 Ben quit school and became
a cabinetmaker. His appreciation for woodwork and his understanding of what made a good skateboard,
combined to ignite in Ben an intense passion for skateboard manufacturing.

With no information on ‘how to’ around the manufacturing process, Ben invested everything he had to
figure it out. His obsession for skateboard manufacturing had begun and  completely consumed his
life. Everyone around him told him he was wasting his time, that ‘there wasn’t enough money in it’
but Ben didn’t care, he had an all-consuming passion for skateboarding that he couldn’t ignore and
he needed to fulfil that call.

From his parent’s garage Ben designed and built his own presses, glue rollers and heat transfer
machine. Ben began to produce skateboards for distributors and retailers packing as many boards as
he could fit into his van and driving around from skate shop to skate shop to sell his wares that he
so painstakingly worked to produce and perfect.

To make his business a success he quickly realised retailers not only wanted the best quality skate
hardware but also needed good margins, reliable supply and dependable service.

Since those early days Absolute’s landscape has broadened to include more brands and a larger
geographical reach, however the heritage and values that the business was founded on continue to be
the driving force behind the success of Absolute Board Co. today.

# Our Brands

### Penny Skateboards

**The Original Plastic Skateboard.**

Penny Skateboards was established for the sole purpose of bringing back the fun into skateboarding.
The original plastic skateboard company has created the global plastic skateboard phenomenon and
still leads the market for product quality and innovation.

Each Penny Skateboard is built with the highest quality raw materials and fanatical attention to
detail. Penny Skateboards are designed and built to look good, perform well, and exceed all your
expectations. Penny Skateboards, since forever.

[ Visit Penny ][8]

### Z-Flex Skateboards

**Generations Strong, Since 1976.**

Since in the beginning of the Dogtown era of Southern California, Z-Flex Skateboards has continued
to push the boundaries of skateboarding.

Once one of a handful of skate companies finding its way through the infancy of skateboarding,
Z-Flex has endured to become one of the longest running skateboard companies in existence.

Now generations strong, Z-Flex continues its path of determination and dedication to skateboarding.

[ Visit Z-Flex ][9]

### Ookkie Skateboards

**The World’s First Learner Skateboard.**

The Ookkie™ is the world’s first dedicated kids skateboard that has been specifically designed for
children as young as 2 years old. Your child can use the Ookkie with or without assistance from an
adult with its patented 4 in one construction.

We’ve combined fun with early development! Ookkie parents all around the world have loved seeing the
way their child has developed their balance and core stability as a result of riding the Ookkie.

[ Visit Ookkie ][10]

Blue Bay has two factory sites and own one special workshop to produce EPS surfboard and
PU surfboard. Shortboard, Fishboard, Funboard, Longboard all can do OEM. Size can be 4’ to 9’10’’.
We have precious CNC shape machine to make any shape customer require. All process are made by hand.
EPS Surfboard Annuel output is about 3000pcs.

EPS surfboard become more popular these days. EPS foam is much lighter than PU, making it a great
option for surfers that love to take it to the air. Lighter boards are easier to whip around
quickly. This extra sensitivity is the perfect construction for progressive surfing on waves that
let you perform quick, snappy maneuvers.

It’s divided according to the size and shape: EPS Shortboard, EPS Fishboard, EPS Funboard, EPS
Longboard.
Foam core density has 22kgs/m3 & 35kgs/m3. Others can be customized.
If you have any OEM order for EPS surfboard, Please feel free to contact with us. Welcome to inquiry
on us!

### [PU Surfboard][96]

#### PU Surfboard

Blue Bay business start from PU surfboard manufactures, through 20years development, products expand
to PU surfboard/EPS surfboard/Soft Top Surfboard/Bodyboard/SUP/Skimboard whole industry chain.

We have one special workshop to produce EPS/PU surfboard. Shortboard, Fishboard, Funboard, Longboard
all can do OEM. Size can be 4’ to 9’10’’. We have precious CNC shape machine to make any shape
customer require. All process are made by hand. PU Surfboard Annuel output is 2000pcs.

If you have any OEM order for PU surfboard, Please feel free to contact with us. Welcome to inquiry
on us!

#### **OEM  Surfboard, SUP manufacturing and Surf Accessory manufacturer based in China.**

*Hello and welcome to Blue Sea Watersports. The first and only surfboard factory in China, 100%
owned and hands-on operated by western surfers & board makers. Here at Blue Sea, we specialise in
the manufacture of high-end quality SUP manufacturing, Surfboards & Surf Accessories and we are
extremely proud to call some of the World’s biggest brands as clients. *

**We have over 40 years experience making surfcraft,** including 10 years of hands-on experience in

# Action sports distributor

Our mission as international distributor is to expand the passion for action sports! Our products
target advanced and dedicated riders, but we find great pride in introducing new riders as well.
We partner with great brands and great shops. We distribute boards of all kinds, scooters, skates,
snow, and a lot of surf equipment.

### We want you to succeed!

We offer product data and images of high quality. Save time gathering data and uploading products -

# Action sports distributor

Our mission as international distributor is to expand the passion for action sports! Our products
target advanced and dedicated riders, but we find great pride in introducing new riders as well.
We partner with great brands and great shops. We distribute boards of all kinds, scooters, skates,
snow, and a lot of surf equipment.

### We want you to succeed!

We offer product data and images of high quality. Save time gathering data and uploading products -
we acknowledge that time is spend better advising and helping customers!

# A ONE-STOP SHOP FOR THE SERIAL PRODUCTION OF STRONG, LIGHT AND BEAUTIFUL COMPOSITE PRODUCTIONS

Cobra group of companies (“COBRA”) is one of the world's largest OEM manufacturers of composite
products. With it heritage in Watersports, it has developed a strong reputation in the core markets
of Windsurfing, Surfing, Stand up Paddle (SUP), and Kitesurfing.

Throughout its history, COBRA has continued to innovate and has expanded its product range beyond
Watersports, to become a world-class manufacturer of selected high-end composite parts across a
range of specialised market sectors, including Automotive, Composite Structures (Architectural and
Transport), Marine, and Luxury Accessories.

COBRA is the ideal manufacturing partner for high end fiber-reinforced products and components. With
solutions tailored to specific needs, but always with a focus on being strong, light and beautiful,
COBRA manufactures a myriad of components for customers worldwide.

### ONE-STOP SHOP

Nearly twenty years ago, COBRA introduced the concept of the ‘one-stop shop’. It has continued to be
a popular approach with customers, ensuring a comprehensive range of products, technologies and
turn-key solutions can be accessed at all stages of their project. COBRA works with customers from
initial design concept, through product development, prototyping and testing, culminating in
consistent, high quality series production.

Together with the variety of its technologies and products, these make COBRA a very convenient ‘One
Stop Shop’ for world renowned customers, many of whom buy their products exclusively from COBRA.
* Purpose-built Design & Development Center
* Product setup
* Mold-making technologies
* Range of component manufacturing techniques
* Various finishing processes
* Environmentally-conscious approach to manufacturing

[explore][30]

### SHAPE YOUR DREAMS

In 2018, COBRA’s dedicated workforce of 2,500 employees at its 100,000 m² state-of-the-art
production facilities is celebrating 40 years of producing high quality composite parts using the
latest technologies and materials.

The company prides itself on its turn-key solutions for the construction of Strong, Light and
Beautiful composites components. COBRA is in a unique position, ready for the ‘coming of age’ of
composites, where (almost) anything is possible.

[explore][31]

### CORE VALUE

COBRA’s Strong, Light and Beautiful composite products have excited millions of people around the
world, setting the bar for quality across many market sectors.

Building on 40 years of composites experience, COBRA has successfully expanded its core value of
‘strong, light and beautiful’ into market sectors such as Automotive, Architectural, Transportation,
Marine and Luxury Accessories, building parts for leading brands in Germany, Italy, Japan, and the
United Kingdom.

Yes, you can buy a board and later bring it back to sell.

Yes. Come get a custom estimation of your gear’s worth and find something new to trade for.

You can visit Coconut Peet’s at 3231 India Street, in San Diego, near the airport.

# High performance,

## low impact, endless adventure.

### Why are our surfboards sustainable?

##### We use eco-friendly materials

**Cork** is made of bark from the cork oak; this material has the advantage of being light,
water-proof, flexible, buoyant and best of it all sustainable! The cork trees are not cut down, as
the bark keeps on growing and the cork can be harvested many times. Cork, is one of the most
sustainable materials as it is self-regenerating.

To keep transport distances short, we source our Cork from Portugal. The trees are able to live
between 150 to 200 years and produce a lot of cork during their lifetime!

Our Collective boards are handcrafted by experienced shapers using a recyclable eps core with
**pawlonia wood** and natural **cork**. Between the pawlonia wood and the eps core we use a layer of
linen for extra durability. These boards are very resistant thanks to the pawlonia wood
reinforcements that we use in the cork edges and in the fin boxes. To keep the manufacturing process
as sustainable as possible and at the same time lighten the weight of the boards we do not use
fiberglass. All our boards have a ventilated leash plug to avoid possible delaminations.

Boards made using recycled blanks with a **resin tint** finish; The surfboards are made from
recycled blanks, utilizing plant oil-based resin and non-toxic pigments. To ensure sustainability,
we source our polyurethane blanks from a nearby small business located just 20km away from our
workshop. These blanks are created with over 80% recycled polyol and MDI-based memory foam, which
reduces toxicity for workers involved in the manufacturing process. Additionally, the inclusion of a
wooden component enhances their durability and resistance to dents.

# High performance,

## low impact, endless adventure.

### Why are our surfboards sustainable?

##### We use eco-friendly materials

**Cork** is made of bark from the cork oak; this material has the advantage of being light,
water-proof, flexible, buoyant and best of it all sustainable! The cork trees are not cut down, as
the bark keeps on growing and the cork can be harvested many times. Cork, is one of the most
sustainable materials as it is self-regenerating.

To keep transport distances short, we source our Cork from Portugal. The trees are able to live
between 150 to 200 years and produce a lot of cork during their lifetime!

Our Collective boards are handcrafted by experienced shapers using a recyclable eps core with
**pawlonia wood** and natural **cork**. Between the pawlonia wood and the eps core we use a layer of
linen for extra durability. These boards are very resistant thanks to the pawlonia wood
reinforcements that we use in the cork edges and in the fin boxes. To keep the manufacturing process
as sustainable as possible and at the same time lighten the weight of the boards we do not use
fiberglass. All our boards have a ventilated leash plug to avoid possible delaminations.

Boards made using recycled blanks with a **resin tint** finish; The surfboards are made from
recycled blanks, utilizing plant oil-based resin and non-toxic pigments. To ensure sustainability,
we source our polyurethane blanks from a nearby small business located just 20km away from our
workshop. These blanks are created with over 80% recycled polyol and MDI-based memory foam, which
reduces toxicity for workers involved in the manufacturing process. Additionally, the inclusion of a
wooden component enhances their durability and resistance to dents.

# Free Online Games at CrazyGames

CrazyGames features the latest and best free online games. You can enjoy playing fun games without
interruptions from downloads, intrusive ads, or pop-ups. Just load up your favorite games instantly
in your web browser and enjoy the experience.

You can play our games on desktop and mobile devices. That includes everything from desktop PCs,
laptops, and Chromebooks, to the latest smartphones and tablets from Apple and Android. You can also
install CrazyGames as a mobile app, both on [Android][66] and on [iOS][67].

## About CrazyGames

There are plenty of online multiplayer games with active communities on CrazyGames. You can find
many of the best free multiplayer titles on our[ .io games ][68]page. In these games, you can play
with your friends online and with other people from around the world, no matter where you are.

## Play our Best Games

CrazyGames has over 4,500 fun games in every genre you can imagine. Some of our most popular games
are:
* [Shell Shockers][69]
* [Agar io][70]
* [Uno Online][71]
* [Geometry Dash][72]
* [Moto X3M][73]
* [Smash Karts][74]
* [GeoGuessr][75]
* [Hangman][76]

## Explore by Genre

You’ll find the main categories like [clicker][77], [driving games][78], and [shooting games][79] at
the top of any page, but there’s also a range of subcategories that will help you find the perfect
game. Popular tags include [car games][80], [Minecraft][81], [2-player games][82], [match 3
games][83], and [mahjong.][84]

## Suggest a Game

Is there a game that you love, but you can't find on CrazyGames? [Suggest a game][85] to us, and
we'll see what we can do to get it. You can also [contact us][86] for any general suggestions or
improvements.

## About CrazyGames

CrazyGames is a free browser gaming platform founded in 2014 by Raf Mertens. Since then, the
platform has grown to over 30 million monthly users.

Our mission is simple: to create a browser-gaming platform that works seamlessly for users around
the world and rewards developers both big and small. Visit our corporate site and learn more [about
CrazyGames][87].

It is a great way to making potential buyers believe they are buying an American Made Product.  Not
sure exactly what to call this but it is

clearly misdirecting consumers. 

Why do they advertise products this way?  Money!

Lets work together to help consumers buy skateboards that are Made In USA.  It is a Good Feeling to
support what we all work so hard for.  Mark it! or Leave it!

 


1440 x 1440 DPI High-fidelity Printing (Hi-FI)

Skateboard printing is done in many ways.  We have been printing on skateboards since the early 90's
with digital technology.  While others were still screen printing on decks we were using color
copiers to print on a paper transfer material.  This was the start of a whole new way of thinking. 
It took the industry more then 15 years to start figuring out how to digitally print on
skateboards.  Being a pioneer of digital ink used to make skateboard graphics we take pride knowing
we were the first to use this process.  Having this all to ourselves for over 10 years gave us the
advantage to improve on how it was done.

 

The use of CMYK LC LM brings High-Fidelity printing to the market also known as (Hi-Fi). Along with
1440x1440 High Definition dots per inch enables you to have your art printed like it was a for an
art gallery.

 

High resolution printing will reproduce art only as good as what you provide so make sure you zoom
into your art before uploading to see if it blurry.  Make it look the same size as a deck on your
computer screen and if it looks clear you are good to go.

 

 

 

Why customskateboards.com® ?

There are many reasons to have your boards printed with a custom skateboard image.

friends.

3. Turn your art into something cool then start selling them to start your own company.

4. The prices are cheaper then pro brand name decks that you will find at any skate shop.

Compare Made in USA to 100% American / Canadian Maple

It is like comparing **Apples** to **Oranges**.

Made in USA is just that it is Made in USA.  

If a company does not mark or advertise that it is USA Made then it is not. 

## What Does 100% American / Canadian Maple Mean? = It Does Not Mean Made In USA

It is a great way to making potential buyers believe they are buying an American Made Product.  Not
sure exactly what to call this but it is

clearly misdirecting consumers. 

Why do they advertise products this way?  Money!

Lets work together to help consumers buy skateboards that are Made In USA.  It is a Good Feeling to
support what we all work so hard for.  Mark it! or Leave it!

 


1440 x 1440 DPI High-fidelity Printing (Hi-FI)

Skateboard printing is done in many ways.  We have been printing on skateboards since the early 90's
with digital technology.  While others were still screen printing on decks we were using color
copiers to print on a paper transfer material.  This was the start of a whole new way of thinking. 
It took the industry more then 15 years to start figuring out how to digitally print on
skateboards.  Being a pioneer of digital ink used to make skateboard graphics we take pride knowing
we were the first to use this process.  Having this all to ourselves for over 10 years gave us the
advantage to improve on how it was done.

 

The use of CMYK LC LM brings High-Fidelity printing to the market also known as (Hi-Fi). Along with
1440x1440 High Definition dots per inch enables you to have your art printed like it was a for an
art gallery.

 

High resolution printing will reproduce art only as good as what you provide so make sure you zoom
into your art before uploading to see if it blurry.  Make it look the same size as a deck on your
computer screen and if it looks clear you are good to go.

## Dropshippers List

Thinking of selling products online?
You’ve come to the right place. Get Dropshippers is a free dropship merchandise directory featuring
hundreds of wholesalers that will dropship products and merchandise right to your customers’ door.
We have a growing number of categories with cheap wholesale products to choose from.

There are many advantages to dropshipping, like:

1) You don’t have to keep an inventory of wholesale products
2) Your business start-up cost are drastically reduced, because of no inventory (no large warehouse
necessary)
3) You can focus on promoting and marketing your website
4) A lot of drop ship companies offer wholesale prices on their products

Many websites force you to pay for a list of dropshippers, but we believe that this information
should be made available for free to all visitors. That is why we have created this free dropship
directory. So feel free to browse around the web site, as we are sure that you will find what you
are looking for.

**Buyers:** The wholesale drop ship products offered from the vendors in our directory are perfect
for an ecommerce site, eBay auction site, Amazon FBA, or any other website that sells products at
retail prices.

**Suppliers:** If your company offers drop shipping and you would like to be listed on our
wholesalers directory, then please use our Free Listing page to be listed in our resource. There’s a
full listing of Dropshippers here. We also offer Enhanced Ads for drop ship company that want even
more exposure.

Note: Not all dropship companies are the same. Some companies are wholesalers that will dropship
their products for you. Other companies are just middlemen who buy from wholesalers and then drop
ship the products for you. Both types of vendor are good, the only difference is that the latter
type of vendor will usually charge more for the products. The middleman dropshipping company’s
benefits are that they usually offer a large range of wholesale merchandise to sell online and they
usually help you to get set up and start selling their goods. Please do your own research as to what
type of drop shipper your are dealing with. [What is Drop Shipping?][73]

We are here to make the most progressive and fastest boards on the water and the gear to help your
journey. With no prejudice we build it all. Our passion for board building is rooted in the process

our craft. The range of products we build are rooted through a family lineage of board shapers with
love for the ocean since 1970. You are now part of the family “InfinTREE” thank you for stopping
by.

## **About Me**

Hi I’m Nick, shaper and creator of Insieme Surf. I started making surfboards while living in Santa
Cruz, California. Space was hard to come by, and I was building boards everywhere from my concrete
patch in front of our beach shack, to a 10x8 storage unit at the local self storage establishment.
Now having traveled up and down the North American west coast for a handful of years and surfing
waves more typical of the rest of the world, the spectrum of shapes and alternative sizes in my
shaping repertoire has increased greatly. I’m excited to open that landscape of limitless
possibilities up to you, and share the joy of custom surfboards

patch in front of our beach shack, to a 10x8 storage unit at the local self storage establishment.
Now having traveled up and down the North American west coast for a handful of years and surfing
waves more typical of the rest of the world, the spectrum of shapes and alternative sizes in my
shaping repertoire has increased greatly. I’m excited to open that landscape of limitless
possibilities up to you, and share the joy of custom surfboards

##### CHANGE THE FACE OF ARCHITECTURE

## Discover the possibilities

At Longboard, innovation, sustainability and quality are intertwined in architectural products to
meet the expectations of your unparalleled designs.

Combining the beauty of wood and specialty building product finishes, with the durability and
longevity of extruded aluminum. We understand the design and building process is not simply applying
a predefined solution. It’s choosing exquisite materials without compromising performance. It’s the
ease of installation and how quickly our products arrive on your job site. It’s positively impacting
the environment while inspiring the people and communities around us.

Changing the face of architecture is all-encompassing, it’s the ultimate goal we can achieve
together.

[ The Longboard Difference ][164]

## Our Solutions

### Architects
* A wide range of products for [interior][165] and [exterior][166] applications
* Full [testing documentation][167], [BIM library][168] and live technical support
* Rapid [sample fulfilment][169]

### Contractors
* Products designed for simple, efficient installation for enhanced profitability
* Well documented [installation guides][170] and [installation videos][171]
* Popular finishes ready to ship within one week
* Material takeoff lists and shop drawings

### Building Owners
* Products designed to stand the test of time
* Zero maintenance
* [Energy code compliance][172]        and reducing embodied carbon
* [Residential Solutions][173]

##### CHANGE THE FACE OF ARCHITECTURE

## Discover the possibilities

At Longboard, innovation, sustainability and quality are intertwined in architectural products to
meet the expectations of your unparalleled designs.

Combining the beauty of wood and specialty building product finishes, with the durability and
longevity of extruded aluminum. We understand the design and building process is not simply applying
a predefined solution. It’s choosing exquisite materials without compromising performance. It’s the
ease of installation and how quickly our products arrive on your job site. It’s positively impacting
the environment while inspiring the people and communities around us.

Changing the face of architecture is all-encompassing, it’s the ultimate goal we can achieve
together.

[ The Longboard Difference ][164]

### Architects
* A wide range of products for [interior][165] and [exterior][166] applications
* Full [testing documentation][167], [BIM library][168] and live technical support

* Products designed for simple, efficient installation for enhanced profitability
* Well documented [installation guides][170] and [installation videos][171]
* Popular finishes ready to ship within one week
* Material takeoff lists and shop drawings

### Building Owners
* Products designed to stand the test of time
* Zero maintenance
* [Energy code compliance][172]        and reducing embodied carbon
* [Residential Solutions][173]

## What we're all about

Our parent company [Maxam Surf][70] began in 1996 as a family owned and operated business that
specialized in the production of custom surfboards for numerous renowned global brands. Over the
years, we have formed many partnerships within the surfing community and increasingly fell in love
with the sport and industry.

Wanting to make our own impact, we created “M21 Surf” in 2005 as a company that made surfboards and
related gear at reasonable price in the hopes of making surfing more attainable and accessible to
beginner - intermediate surfers. In 2008, operating as a brick and mortar store in Chino, CA has
allowed us to have a foot print in the Inland Empire surfing community. 

However, like many “Inlanders” we don’t just love to surf. We love to skate and snowboard as well.
Having had the privilege to meet and build relationships with people, we recognized that many felt
the same. Thus, we created “M21 Sports” to cater to our Inland Empire community and beyond. Whether
if it’s skating, surfing, or snowboarding, we got you covered. We know why you love it, and we love
it too.

## What we're all about

Our parent company [Maxam Surf][70] began in 1996 as a family owned and operated business that
specialized in the production of custom surfboards for numerous renowned global brands. Over the
years, we have formed many partnerships within the surfing community and increasingly fell in love
with the sport and industry.

Wanting to make our own impact, we created “M21 Surf” in 2005 as a company that made surfboards and
related gear at reasonable price in the hopes of making surfing more attainable and accessible to
beginner - intermediate surfers. In 2008, operating as a brick and mortar store in Chino, CA has
allowed us to have a foot print in the Inland Empire surfing community. 

However, like many “Inlanders” we don’t just love to surf. We love to skate and snowboard as well.
Having had the privilege to meet and build relationships with people, we recognized that many felt
the same. Thus, we created “M21 Sports” to cater to our Inland Empire community and beyond. Whether
if it’s skating, surfing, or snowboarding, we got you covered. We know why you love it, and we love
it too.

# Surfboard

Surfboard is a proxy utility tool compatible with Surge config.

### 如何安装
* [Google Play][12]
* [APK 下载][13]

### 新闻
* [Twitter][14]
* [Telegram News Channel][15]
* [Telegram User Group][16]

### 如何使用

如果您有 Surge 3/4 配置，导入使用即可

### 支持的协议
* HTTP/HTTPS/SOCK5/SOCKS5 over TLS
* SS/SS-OBFS
* VMess
* Trojan

### 单独支持的功能
* bypass 的 app 不会进入 VPN 模块
* PROCESS-NAME 规则（使用包名）

### 受限不支持的功能
* MITM （[Android 官方不支持][17]）
* URL Rewrite
* 规则类型
  * USER-AGENT（MITM 不支持了）
  * URL-REGEX（请用 DOMAIN-SUFFIX 这类更好的）

# Premium Motorized Surfboards & Water Tech Solutions

Official Distribution · Sales · Rental Solutions
[Europe][6] [UAE][7] [ Россия][8]

## About MOTOSURFING

### Leading the Future of Water Sports Technology

MOTOSURFING is a premium distributor and integrator of motorized surfboards and electric water
sports technology. We operate in Russia and the Middle East, delivering high-performance watercraft
for private clients and rental businesses.

Our mission is to bring cutting-edge water tech to exclusive resorts, marinas, and private yacht
owners, backed by premium service and deep technical expertise.

## Our Solutions

### Three Ways We Serve the Market

[

#### Retail & Private Clients

Premium sales and service for individual water sports enthusiasts and private collectors.

][9]
[

#### Rental & Resorts

Complete rental solutions for beach resorts, hotels, and tourist destinations.

][10]
[

#### Yacht & Marina Solutions

Bespoke watercraft integration for superyachts, marinas, and exclusive clubs.

][11]
As the largest online store for water tech, we specialize in electric surfboards, e-foils, and jet
surfs—delivering premium performance to enthusiasts worldwide. Visit our showrooms to experience the
gear firsthand, from thrilling rides to luxury gifts perfect for any occasion. With global shipping
and personalized consultations, we make elite water sports accessible. Discover top-tier options and
elevate your adventures—contact our head office today.
[Contact us][12]
Our company brings proven expertise in launching rental businesses. We power jetsurf competitions
that thrill crowds, while our Motosurfing franchise model simplifies starting your own board and
water tech rental operation. From setup to ongoing support, we ensure seamless profitability. Boost
your resort's appeal—reach out now for franchise opportunities or custom solutions.
[Contact us][13]
We cater to yacht owners with curated luxury equipment and entertainment tech, enhancing onboard
experiences with seamless integration. As the official distributor of Seabob underwater scooters, we
provide elite propulsion systems, custom setups, and maintenance for marinas and superyachts.
Compact, powerful, and safe—our solutions redefine waterside leisure. Transform your vessel
today—connect with our team for exclusive consultations.
[Contact us][14]

## Our Markets

### Global Presence, Local Expertise

[

#### Russia

Distribution, retail sales, and strategic rental partnerships across major coastal cities and resort
destinations.

][15]
[

#### UAE

Premium resort integrations, exclusive marina solutions, and superyacht water sports technology in
Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

][16]
[

#### Europe

Market expansion, B2B partnerships, and pilot rental projects across Mediterranean and Atlantic
coastal regions.

][17]

## Partner with Us

### Let's Build the Future Together

#### Request Partnership

Join our network of premium distributors and technology partners.

[Contact us][18]

#### Become a Dealer

Expand your portfolio with premium motorized watercraft.

[Apply now][19]

#### Request Demo

Experience our technology firsthand at your location.

[Book demo][20]

# PSI SURFBOARD MANUFACTURING

Surfboard Manufacturer based in East Java, Indonesia. Producing the highest quality surfboards for
the leading surfboard brands across the globe.

[Get in touch][3]






#### SUPPLYING MARKETS AROUND THE WORLD SINCE 2010



#### GOING GLOBAL

Founded in 2010 and based in East Java, Indonesia, PSI Manufacturing has rapidly become a strong
part of the Australian and International Surfboard Manufacturing landscape. A professional
establishment dedicated to designing and producing high quality surfboards for brands around the
world.

[Get in touch][4]
R

#### EXPERT TEAM

The PSI Manufacturing staff make up the most experienced team in board-building, many of them in the
industry for decades. The factory supports the local community by employing over 58 dedicated staff
members, creating a happy and productive working environment.

[Enquire][5]

## Only the best products make the best boards

#### Blanks

Made by Core Industries we use quality surfboard blanks

#### Carbon Fiber

We trust in Colan Australia for the carbon fiber in our surfboards.

#### Fin Systems

We use genuine FCS and Futures fin systems in all our boards.

#### Cloths

We use superior grade Cloths for all of our surfboards.

#### Resin

We use FGI formulated surfboard resin from Allnex composites Int.

#### Stringers

We use high grade Paulownia wood for the stringers in our surfboards.

## Our Key Raw Material

Using top of the line products from Australia and the States and delivering surfboards manufactured
to the highest quality standards. 

#### FGI FORMULATED RESIN

Specialised resin from Allnex composites Int. 

#### core industries blanks

Raw Chems from Australia

#### superior CLOTH

Highest standard cloth for excellent results.

[Get in touch][6]

100%

## QUALITY GUARANTEED

[GET IN TOUCH][7]

## Surfboard Brands

We collaborate with a range of international shapers, who visit the factory regularly to perfect
their models and innovate on surfboard shape and design.

### AKUSHAPER MACHINES

PSI Manufacturing uses AkuShaper, the world’s premier custom surfboard shaping machine and software
suite.


AkuShaper is the only surfboard cutting machine with its own integrated hardware and software
surfboard shaping package.


The system was created to preserve the art of the custom surfboard. It is designed to help shapers
keep their direct relationship with surfers and protect surfing from the loss of personalisation in
other industries.


AkuShaper is the best in the industry at accurate and rapid alignment of blanks, allowing a fast and
seamless production of boards.  Their unique cutter is the most effective technique for cutting
boards, delivering perfect rails. 

WE WORK WITH RENOWN SHAPERS FROM AROUND THE WORLD. TRUSTED BY THE BEST, PRODUCING ONLY THE BEST.

 

“Thanks boys you’re doing a  great job!”

Phil Myers – Free Flight Surfboards

“The quality surfboards we receive are testimony to the hard work that’s going on in all aspects
behind the scenes… Sideways are stoked to be involved with such a great crew and to be alongside
such great shapers!!”

Leah Tupper – Sideways

 

“Keep up the great work crew! Feedback so far has been amazing”

Rodney Dahlberg – Dahlberg Surfboards

**+ 6231 – 7492878**

#### Location

(Komplek Pergudangan Margomulyo),
Surabaya, East Java,
Indonesia.


 

Email 

 

[nene@psisurfboards.com][8]

## Surfboard Brands

We collaborate with a range of international shapers, who visit the factory regularly to perfect
their models and innovate on surfboard shape and design.

### AKUSHAPER MACHINES

PSI Manufacturing uses AkuShaper, the world’s premier custom surfboard shaping machine and software
suite.


AkuShaper is the only surfboard cutting machine with its own integrated hardware and software
surfboard shaping package.


The system was created to preserve the art of the custom surfboard. It is designed to help shapers
keep their direct relationship with surfers and protect surfing from the loss of personalisation in
other industries.


AkuShaper is the best in the industry at accurate and rapid alignment of blanks, allowing a fast and
seamless production of boards.  Their unique cutter is the most effective technique for cutting
boards, delivering perfect rails. 

WE WORK WITH RENOWN SHAPERS FROM AROUND THE WORLD. TRUSTED BY THE BEST, PRODUCING ONLY THE BEST.

Where on South Padre Island do we meet for our surfing lesson?

arrive 15 minutes early so that we can start on time. Park by the jetty bait stand. Look for my
black truck with boards, or I may already be on the beach by the jetty with lessons, look for Astro
and surfboards!

How do I pay?

Pay cash at check-in. No deposit required, but reservations should be made in advance. 

Can non-swimmers take lessons?

Yes! I often teach non-swimmers! Lessons are held in shallow water where you can stand, swimming
skills not required!

Are surfing lessons for all ages?

Yes! I've taught thousands of small children as young as 7 months, and adults into their 70's.

What do I need to bring?

Safe soft surfboards are included with the lesson. Bring water, sunblock and a towel. And if you're
like me, maybe some food! Surfing makes me so hungry!

Can I have a private surf lesson?

are wanting private instruction or advanced technique instruction, I'll work with you.

How do I sign up?

What time are lessons held?

Summer surf lessons are held daily mornings only from 8-9am. Off season lessons are typically
afternoons unless requested earlier.

How much do surfing lessons cost?

available at additional cost. Private lessons are also additional cost. Text 956-772-7272 for exact
pricing. Will meet or beat any price! 

Do you rent surfboards?

Yes, safe soft surfboards are available for rent at a daily fee of $30. Many students want to
continue surfing, so let me know if you want to surf all day! Pickup and delivery available at
additional fee.

How big are the waves on South Padre Island?

Common question! Summer waves are generally smaller in the 1-4' range which is best for learning.

water where you can stand. Safety is my priority, swimming skills not required. You couldn't be in
better hands!

What if it rains?

We surf rain or shine! I only cancel if there is lightning. It rarely rains here, you'll be getting
wet regardless! If possible we may postpone lessons for an hour or two if rain is heavy.

What about the red flag?

there are waves and that's what we are here for!! If the surf becomes rough we stay close to shore

predator sharks.  Jellyfish are fairly rare and similar to ant bites. Rip currents are common during
large surf, but you will be taught about them and as a surfer how they are your friend. The ocean is
ALIVE and not a chlorinated pool, you'll be taught to enjoy it safely the rest of your life!

## Frequently Asked Questions for Surfing Lessons

Please message me at 956-772-7272 if you cannot find an answer to your surf lesson question.

Where on South Padre Island do we meet for our surfing lesson?

We meet on the beach at [Isla Blanca Beach Park][49] by the jetty. $12 gate fee at the park. Please
arrive 15 minutes early so that we can start on time. Park by the jetty bait stand. Look for my
black truck with boards, or I may already be on the beach by the jetty with lessons, look for Astro
and surfboards!

How do I pay?

Pay cash at check-in. No deposit required, but reservations should be made in advance. 

Can non-swimmers take lessons?

Yes! I often teach non-swimmers! Lessons are held in shallow water where you can stand, swimming
skills not required!

Are surfing lessons for all ages?

Yes! I've taught thousands of small children as young as 7 months, and adults into their 70's.

What do I need to bring?

Safe soft surfboards are included with the lesson. Bring water, sunblock and a towel. And if you're
like me, maybe some food! Surfing makes me so hungry!

Can I have a private surf lesson?

Yes, I offer private surfing and ocean safety instruction for you or your small group. Whether you
are wanting private instruction or advanced technique instruction, I'll work with you.

How do I sign up?

Reservations are required in advance, simply text or call 956-772-7272. No deposit required.

What time are lessons held?

Summer surf lessons are held daily mornings only from 8-9am. Off season lessons are typically
afternoons unless requested earlier.

How much do surfing lessons cost?

One hour lessons are most common, pricing depends on how many in your group. Longer lessons are
available at additional cost. Private lessons are also additional cost. Text 956-772-7272 for exact
pricing. Will meet or beat any price! 

Do you rent surfboards?

Yes, safe soft surfboards are available for rent at a daily fee of $30. Many students want to
continue surfing, so let me know if you want to surf all day! Pickup and delivery available at
additional fee.

How big are the waves on South Padre Island?

Common question! Summer waves are generally smaller in the 1-4' range which is best for learning.
The rest of the year the surf can get quite large, but regardless of wave size I teach in shallow
water where you can stand. Safety is my priority, swimming skills not required. You couldn't be in
better hands!

What if it rains?

We surf rain or shine! I only cancel if there is lightning. It rarely rains here, you'll be getting
wet regardless! If possible we may postpone lessons for an hour or two if rain is heavy.

What about the red flag?

The Red Flag is nearly always flown as a general precaution to swimmers and beachgoers. It means
there are waves and that's what we are here for!! If the surf becomes rough we stay close to shore
in shallow water. Remember, you are with one of the world's most experienced ocean professionals!

Rip currents, jellyfish, sharks oh my!!

South Padre Island is one of the safest beaches in the world for beginner surfers. We don't have
predator sharks.  Jellyfish are fairly rare and similar to ant bites. Rip currents are common during
large surf, but you will be taught about them and as a surfer how they are your friend. The ocean is
ALIVE and not a chlorinated pool, you'll be taught to enjoy it safely the rest of your life!

## A B O U T

## OUR STORY

The Strive Surfboards brand was founded in 2000 because one day an 11 year old grom rode his first
wave and was hooked. It was fun. It was cool. It was all Jon Henderson could think about!  

Strive is the perpetual continuation of that deep love for surfing. We are inspired to learn, to
grow, to always improve so we can bring you the best boards. We build the boards that go on surf
trips to far away dream worlds.  We design the boards that paddle in early and get over the ledge on
drops that seemed impossible. We create the boards that give us precious moments of sanity in a
crazy world.

Strive Surfboards are proven from Jaws to Ruggles, RI; from Pipeline to Alabama Point Jetty; from
Mavericks to Cornwall, UK; from Nazaré to Chiba, Japan; from Teahupo’o to San-O. We are proud to
build boards for everyone, everywhere.

## OUR COMMITMENT

Strive will continue to keep finding new ways to make all types surfing even more fun, while
honoring surfing’s roots, style, spirit, culture and everything that makes surfing the coolest thing
ever.

## MEET YOUR SHAPER : Jon Henderson

I founded the Strive Surfboards brand because one day when I was 11 years old, my sister’s boyfriend
let me tag along to the beach and borrow one of his boards. Most of us can clearly remember that
moment when we first felt the stoke of riding a wave and we knew we were destined to be a surfer.
For me it was the most profound awakening of my young life. 

I was always making something (mostly a mess in dad’s garage) and I immediately started building all
kinds of boards from whatever scrap materials I could find; skim boards, paipo’s, even a skateboard
with a sail so I could ‘windsurf’ down my street. I was stoked, I wanted to try everything, and
building the boards was as fulfilling as riding them.

Santa Cruz, California is home.  It is a beautiful place with amazing waves and great surfers. Santa
Cruz has a very rich tradition of great board builders, and it is humbling to find a place among
them. I have also been lucky to travel the world making boards.  I have built boards in 8 countries,
on 4 continents.  I spent 15 years working internationally as a designer and production manager for
dozens of brands with production of 20,000+ boards per year, of all kinds of boards: Surfboards,
Stand-Up Paddle boards (Race, Wave, Recreational), Prone Paddleboards, Wake Surfboards, Kite boards,
even Bodyboards. Surfboards have always been my passion and primary focus, but I am so grateful to
have learned about hydrodynamics, materials, design, structural engineering, and production
processes from across such a wide spectrum of water craft.

I love surfing. I love surfboards.

MAKE SURFING MORE FUN.   KEEP SURFING COOL.

## S U R F B O A R D S

## STEP-UP

A step-up is your everyday shortboard, but slightly more serious, more reliable. When conditions
pick up a bit, bigger, steeper, faster, more critical, most typical performance shortboards can
start to redline. In these prime wave conditions the last thing anyone wants is to hold back, you
want to be free to meet power with power. Our step-up’s start with the performance shapes, we add a
bit of length, a little more rocker.  We maintain performance design characteristics, blended with
utilities which allow maximum power and control. 

## BIG BOY

The physically larger surfers just might be the most under-served group when it comes to available
shapes in most surf shops. The redesigned Strive Bully model is a modern high-performance board for
“big guys” looking to have serious fun in everyday conditions.  We started with a performance rocker
and bottom shape, and then gave it a more generous outline and more volume under the chest.  The big
brothers and uncles will easily catch tons of waves and throw serious spray.

## MID-LENGTH

Mid-Length’s have shaken off the “fun board” tag and are being adopted by more performance surfers
looking for fun in conditions which do not always warrant a regular shortboard. The Strive Solution
is a versatile and reliable performance mid-length.  We set out to design a board that combines
smooth flow in weaker waves, with speed, flow, drive, and turning performance.  Paddles in
effortlessly, moves quickly and turns aggressively, travels easily.

## PERFORMANCE LONGBOARD

Strive’s Incitor performance longboards are designed to blend progressive modern surfing with the
smooth flow of longboarding. These boards are ideally suited for everything from “real world
conditions” of messy beach breaks, to ruler-straight point waves. The Strive Incitor Model longboard
excels across a staggeringly broad range: expert to beginner; 2′-15′ waves; beach breaks, points, or
reefs; young or old; male or female. [ Skip to content ][1]

## GUNS

The Strive Surfboards brand was founded in 2000 because one day an 11 year old grom rode his first
wave and was hooked. It was fun. It was cool. It was all Jon Henderson could think about!  

Strive is the perpetual continuation of that deep love for surfing. We are inspired to learn, to
grow, to always improve so we can bring you the best boards. We build the boards that go on surf
trips to far away dream worlds.  We design the boards that paddle in early and get over the ledge on
drops that seemed impossible. We create the boards that give us precious moments of sanity in a
crazy world.

Strive Surfboards are proven from Jaws to Ruggles, RI; from Pipeline to Alabama Point Jetty; from
Mavericks to Cornwall, UK; from Nazaré to Chiba, Japan; from Teahupo’o to San-O. We are proud to
build boards for everyone, everywhere.

## OUR COMMITMENT

Strive will continue to keep finding new ways to make all types surfing even more fun, while
honoring surfing’s roots, style, spirit, culture and everything that makes surfing the coolest thing
ever.

## MEET YOUR SHAPER : Jon Henderson

I founded the Strive Surfboards brand because one day when I was 11 years old, my sister’s boyfriend
let me tag along to the beach and borrow one of his boards. Most of us can clearly remember that
moment when we first felt the stoke of riding a wave and we knew we were destined to be a surfer.
For me it was the most profound awakening of my young life. 

I was always making something (mostly a mess in dad’s garage) and I immediately started building all
kinds of boards from whatever scrap materials I could find; skim boards, paipo’s, even a skateboard
with a sail so I could ‘windsurf’ down my street. I was stoked, I wanted to try everything, and
building the boards was as fulfilling as riding them.

Santa Cruz, California is home.  It is a beautiful place with amazing waves and great surfers. Santa
Cruz has a very rich tradition of great board builders, and it is humbling to find a place among
them. I have also been lucky to travel the world making boards.  I have built boards in 8 countries,
on 4 continents.  I spent 15 years working internationally as a designer and production manager for
dozens of brands with production of 20,000+ boards per year, of all kinds of boards: Surfboards,
Stand-Up Paddle boards (Race, Wave, Recreational), Prone Paddleboards, Wake Surfboards, Kite boards,
even Bodyboards. Surfboards have always been my passion and primary focus, but I am so grateful to
have learned about hydrodynamics, materials, design, structural engineering, and production
processes from across such a wide spectrum of water craft.

I love surfing. I love surfboards.

MAKE SURFING MORE FUN.   KEEP SURFING COOL.

## S U R F B O A R D S

## STEP-UP

A step-up is your everyday shortboard, but slightly more serious, more reliable. When conditions
pick up a bit, bigger, steeper, faster, more critical, most typical performance shortboards can
start to redline. In these prime wave conditions the last thing anyone wants is to hold back, you
want to be free to meet power with power. Our step-up’s start with the performance shapes, we add a
bit of length, a little more rocker.  We maintain performance design characteristics, blended with
utilities which allow maximum power and control. 

## BIG BOY

The physically larger surfers just might be the most under-served group when it comes to available
shapes in most surf shops. The redesigned Strive Bully model is a modern high-performance board for
“big guys” looking to have serious fun in everyday conditions.  We started with a performance rocker
and bottom shape, and then gave it a more generous outline and more volume under the chest.  The big
brothers and uncles will easily catch tons of waves and throw serious spray.

## MID-LENGTH

Mid-Length’s have shaken off the “fun board” tag and are being adopted by more performance surfers
looking for fun in conditions which do not always warrant a regular shortboard. The Strive Solution
is a versatile and reliable performance mid-length.  We set out to design a board that combines
smooth flow in weaker waves, with speed, flow, drive, and turning performance.  Paddles in
effortlessly, moves quickly and turns aggressively, travels easily.

## PERFORMANCE LONGBOARD

Strive’s Incitor performance longboards are designed to blend progressive modern surfing with the
smooth flow of longboarding. These boards are ideally suited for everything from “real world
conditions” of messy beach breaks, to ruler-straight point waves. The Strive Incitor Model longboard
excels across a staggeringly broad range: expert to beginner; 2′-15′ waves; beach breaks, points, or

## PERFORMANCE LONGBOARD

Strive’s Incitor performance longboards are designed to blend progressive modern surfing with the
smooth flow of longboarding. These boards are ideally suited for everything from “real world
conditions” of messy beach breaks, to ruler-straight point waves. The Strive Incitor Model longboard
excels across a staggeringly broad range: expert to beginner; 2′-15′ waves; beach breaks, points, or
reefs; young or old; male or female.  The Inciter is carefully designed to be a ‘go anywhere’ board;
truly for everyone, everywhere!

## TRADITIONAL LONGBOARD

Some things never go out of style, like the glide of a great traditional nose rider. The Strive
Heirloom model offers smooth flow, flawless trim, and timeless feel. One of our most refined shapes,
we have spent decades balancing to foil, determining the ideal bottom and rail contours for smooth
turns, effortless drive, and long tip-time.

## GUNS

Strike Mission Model – With over a quarter century of designing and building big wave guns for
Mavericks, and other big waves around the globe, we are very proud to offer the Strike Mission model
gun. Knowledge, preparation, fitness and proper equipment are critical in big wave surfing. The
Strike Mission features a proven bottom rocker curve with unique foiling of volume to create fast,
responsive, reliable performance balanced with the confidence, predictability, and early entry of a
larger board. All Strike Mission guns come standard with a preinstalled full-deck proprietary EVA
deck pad.  Waves of consequence call for boards of confidence, and serious waves can be serious fun.
